translation.title: Piroxicam Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), tenosynovitis, muscle pain, osteoarticular pain, pain after an injury, and pain after a fracture has healed.
translation.usage: Apply 1 patch to the affected area once a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or to piroxicam preparations, if you have or have had aspirin-induced asthma (an asthma attack caused by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics), if aspirin or another non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesic has caused hives, rhinitis, or angioedema, if the user is a child aged 14 years or under, or if you have been pregnant for 6 months or more. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, if you are elderly, or if you have or have had bronchial asthma, a gastrointestinal ulcer, bleeding or perforation, peptic ulcer, liver impairment, or kidney impairment. Do not use it on skin with lesions (haemorrhagic skin disease, eczema, infected lesions, burns, wounds), on the eyes, or on mucous membranes. Do not use an occlusive dressing. If your symptoms do not improve after about one week of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you use it together with an anticoagulant. Local itching, redness, rash, scaling, eczema, dermatitis, contact dermatitis, or erythema may occur occasionally, and shock or photosensitivity rarely. If any of these occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from light, and keep out of reach of children.
